description: Test suite for Telegram bot helper functions including context normalization, message reply description, mention detection, link expansion, and thread ID resolution.

methods.name: resolveTelegramForumThreadId
methods.description: Determines the forum thread ID based on message properties, resolving IDs for forum and non-forum contexts.

methods.name: resolveTelegramForumFlag
methods.description: Checks if a chat is a forum, using chat data or a fallback getChat call.

methods.name: buildTelegramThreadParams
methods.description: Constructs thread parameters for Telegram API requests based on thread scope and ID.

methods.name: buildTelegramRoutingTarget
methods.description: Builds a routing string for Telegram messages, incorporating chat ID and optional thread ID.

methods.name: buildTypingThreadParams
methods.description: Creates thread parameters for typing indicator requests.

methods.name: resolveTelegramDirectPeerId
methods.description: Determines the peer ID for direct messaging, preferring sender ID when available.

methods.name: normalizeForwardedContext
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes information from forwarded message contexts.

methods.name: describeReplyTarget
methods.description: Analyzes a message to extract reply information, including forwarded contexts.

methods.name: hasBotMention
methods.description: Detects if a bot is mentioned in a message, considering mention text and entities.

methods.name: expandTextLinks
methods.description: Converts text_link entities in message text into Markdown links.
